media.player: native HTML video controls with contain sizing
media.mapping: User-supplied original MP4 files matched by orientation; copied without transcoding.
media.fallback: Original Figma media-layer poster and a loading-error notice.

initialEntries.interaction: Templates opens the existing modal; video generation creates an empty fashion-video node; the other entries show the existing service-not-connected feedback.

singleImageCanvas.imageContent: Dynamic uploaded image, preserving its original aspect ratio.
singleImageCanvas.initialAlignment: Center image and toolbar together inside the canvas below the 48px topbar; keep toolbar at UI scale.

downloadMenu.labels: Format names only, without a Download prefix.
downloadMenu.export: Original pixel dimensions; white background for JPG; validate actual encoded MIME and report unsupported formats.

assetAction.meaning: Save to assets, based on the asset-center icon master.

uploadedVideoCanvas.content: Uploaded video's actual first frame, retaining natural aspect ratio; decoded locally, never auto-playing on the canvas.
uploadedVideoCanvas.upload: Opt-in mixed image/video AssetPicker batch up to 20 files; direct canvas drop also supported. Videos stay out of image-only pickers.
uploadedVideoCanvas.download: Original local video URL, filename and format; no image conversion or format menu.
uploadedVideoCanvas.canvas: Shared Flow selection, movement, zoom, delete, arrange, fit and undo/redo. Retain video URLs across history and release on workspace unmount.
uploadedVideoCanvas.preview: Reuse video preview Dialog and native playback controls; pause on close or workspace switch.

generationSettings.summaryIcon: Uses the same original SVG as the selected ratio option; auto icon only for auto.
generationSettings.interaction: Apply each selection immediately without closing; retain per node across modes with canvas undo/redo. Outside click or Escape closes; use original segmented controls, keyboard selection and shared 200ms motion.

fashionVideoWorkflow.interaction: Source image and prompt shared across modes; last-frame and multiple-reference assets retained separately. Shared single-image picker optionally accepts one local video. Nodes participate in Flow navigation, selection, connections and undo.
fashionVideoWorkflow.generation: Configuration UI only; generation and AI prompt services are not connected.

frames.geometrySource: Resolved instance 84:6150 metadata; generated 64px header differs from actual 44px.

firstLastFrameLayout.label: 首尾帧图
firstLastFrameLayout.emptyEntry: One original plus icon tile opens the existing main-image picker. Once main exists, allow one optional end frame.
firstLastFrameLayout.main: Preview and show a delete button on hover, matching the last frame. Delete clears only this frame and its connection; preserve the canvas source, editor, other frame and settings. The last frame retains its slot and does not become the first frame. Support a single undo transaction.
firstLastFrameLayout.promptAssist: Labelled expand-text button and character counter with 4px gap.
firstLastFrameLayout.history: Generation mode retained per node with undo/redo; switching frame/reference modes preserves all media and settings.

connections.whenFull: Reject additional input with invalid red port feedback; preserve existing images.
connections.binding: Manual edge ID and source image ID are retained on the frame. Deleting either frame removes its corresponding line while preserving the canvas source and other frame, in one undo transaction. Deleting or reconnecting a bound edge updates its frame; reconnecting within the same editor preserves its frame slot.
connections.automaticEdges: Keep toolbar-created main binding; do not duplicate a manual main edge.

firstLastFrameLayout.modeControl: SettingSelect in generation settings row; fast/professional, default fast
firstLastFrameLayout.entry: Initial videoGeneration directly creates the shared 84:6110 frames node.

scope: template dialog and reference image states

connectionRenderingAndReconnect.renderer: Automatic and free connections share the fusion canvas line renderer.
connectionRenderingAndReconnect.selection: A free edge or either endpoint node selected shows a brand-color marching dashed line over a dark underlay at layer 4. Otherwise show a gray solid line at layer -1. Do not highlight unrelated branches through group association.
connectionRenderingAndReconnect.motion: Marching line uses an 800ms linear loop; color and port transitions retain 200ms ease-out. Reduced motion disables marching.
connectionRenderingAndReconnect.reconnect: Keep one visible CanvasConnectionHandle for both connection and reconnection: 16px default, 20px hover, 4px external gap, plus SVG for editors. Native reconnectRadius is 0 to align its center with the Handle; CSS expands only the transparent hit area to 32px and maps hover to the same port.
connectionRenderingAndReconnect.gestures: A click on an editor plus opens its add menu; dragging the reconnect area reconnects only. For multiple selected edges, only the last selected edge exposes reconnectable endpoints to avoid shared-port conflicts.
connectionRenderingAndReconnect.portVisibility: Media ports remain hover-only for node selection; keep the drag origin and explicitly selected edge endpoints visible.

interactionReference.scope: Official documentation supports dragging connections to nodes and retaining media when disconnected. It is not visual verification of port styles or animations.

connectionPointMenu.appearance: Original plus SVG inside both editor connection circles; media output ports remain plain circles.
connectionPointMenu.availability: Frames accept images up to two slots and disable video; references accept images and video.
connectionPointMenu.picker: Reuse AssetPicker with image/video type filtering; single local uploads apply after decoding.
connectionPointMenu.binding: Create media on the clicked side or reuse existing canvas media; connect and fill the frame/main/reference in one undo transaction. Reuse an existing graph edge when present. Removing or reconnecting a bound edge or deleting its media updates the input.
connectionPointMenu.gestures: Click opens menu; native drag-to-connect, compatibility feedback, keyboard access and 200ms transitions remain available.

userOverrides.workflowMainImageRemoval: Frames mode shows delete on hover for both first and last frame thumbnails. Deleting a frame clears only its slot and corresponding connection; preserve the canvas source, editor, prompt, settings and other references, with undo. References mode retains main-image replacement and no main-image delete button; deleting its canvas source or manual binding edge clears the main slot.
userOverrides.templateSidebar: Use the same sidebar in content and empty states: 256px desktop width, shared spacing and selection styles, no horizontal divider below the title.
userOverrides.referenceImagePicker: Reuse the existing AssetPicker in single-image mode for adding and replacing garment/model images. Local uploads apply directly after decoding, without a second Use action.
userOverrides.referenceImageHover: Clip the image and hover overlay inside rounded containers.
userOverrides.workflowBlankAreaDrag: Non-interactive editor space, including blank areas beside frame/reference thumbnails, drags the node. Reference rows remain wheel-scrollable; individual controls still block dragging.
